1.note: A sprint that lost its last master to a retirement is read as a sprint by every tool, with no next action that cannot work.

2.note: An emptied sprint can be edited and commands a master again.

3.note: The emptied-sprint control builds its new series with both code and external-memory plans.

4.note:
The _whole boundary helper distinguishes a raw retirement application result from a projected answer. Raw taskArchive-bearing retirement facts stay direct; projected answers require their retained log. Removed get controls, linkage reportPath, empty topology and reattachment assertions keep their separate surfaces. Earlier carrier account retained literally as historical: Pre/post-retirement get controls assert operation-removed rather than a successful sprint read. Linkage facts come from linkage_report's reportPath; rich retirement/projection state is read through _whole from the retained log. Empty-sprint topology, no impossible next action and reattachment assertions remain distinct from their bounded delivery carriers.
